sources.name: zkapi
sources.role: Privacy daemon zkapi-clientd, the branch the 16 Oct post links. Head committed 10:26Z, 22 minutes before the post, and unchanged since.

sources.name: zkapi-spec-snapshot
sources.role: The later snapshot the spec cites (S06 to S09), 45 commits after the post's commit. Research only; adds the Sepolia staging deployment.

sources.name: zkapi-mainnet
sources.role: The release line behind Open Anonymity's mainnet service (vault 0x4386FDbdA35D995beB3BF8625118Ec5982ec81fe, circuit zkapi-v2-note-bound-v1), head of 6 Nov 2026. Sean chose it on 15 Nov as the deployment Cloak pays through.

sources.name: zkapi-walletd
sources.role: Source of the Rust companion zkapi-walletd that the zkapi-mainnet daemon proves and pays with: the commit its zkapi-clientd/packaging/zkapi-source.env names (OA_COMPANION_COMMIT), 28 Sep 2026, an ancestor of the mainnet release line. Built by guest/build.sh for the guest image, with the tree's companion.patch and guest/pay/companion-start.patch, and by guest/zkapi/build.sh for the trial, with the tree's companion.patch.

sources.name: zkapi-walletd-protocol
sources.role: The companion's protocol submodule (circuits, prover and the proving keys in setup/v2), from the fork its .gitmodules names, at the commit zkapi-walletd records and zkapi-source.env pins (OA_PROTOCOL_COMMIT), 27 Sep 2026. Built with the tree's protocol-transport.patch; its own contract submodules are not needed for the build. Its four proving keys (request.pk, request.vk, withdrawal.pk and withdrawal.vk, 13,720,908 bytes) are all the companion needs at run time beyond its binary, its state and the guest's CA certificates; guest/build.sh puts them in the guest image read-only, and the daemon checks them against the sha256s of its pinned deployment at every start.

sources.name: pi
sources.role: Agent harness. 1.3.0 (15 Oct 19:13Z) was the newest release when the post went out; 1.4.0 followed on 21 Oct.

sources.name: node
sources.role: Node.js runtime for Pi in the guest. 24.22.2 is the version in the stage 1 reference host image (node:24-trixie-slim at the pinned digest); Pi 1.3.0 needs 22.19 or later. Hash as listed in nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt on 12 Nov 2026.

sources.name: tor
sources.role: The Tor Project's own tor for the Mac (Decision 5), run by the host for the guest: tor 0.4.9.16 from the macOS arm64 expert bundle; the stage 1 reference host ran Debian's 0.4.9.15. Hash as listed in the Tor Project's sha256sums-signed-build.txt for 16.0.1 on 12 Nov 2026; that list's signature was not checked.

sources.name: llama.cpp
sources.role: The rewriter engine (decision 8) and Local Llama's answers, built from this source by llama-worker/build-llama.sh with Metal for macOS arm64. Official numbered release b12633 (22 Nov 2026), which includes the merged PR #32694 (`inkling2_loop` architecture) and PR #32704 (per-expert NVFP4 loop-pass scale fix required by Xylolabs NVFP4 and Unsloth Mainline_Support GGUFs, b12611+).

sources.name: mpp
sources.role: The official Machine Payments Protocol toolkit (Rust) the guest's sender pays with (decision 10): Tempo sessions, vouchers, the deposit's close. Pinned exactly in guest/sender/Cargo.toml; guest/sender/Cargo.lock carries the same checksum and the build is --locked. 0.20.0, published 9 Nov 2026, was the newest release on 14 Nov 2026 and is past both advisories on the crate: GHSA-fxc9-7j2w-vx54 (critical, fixed in 0.8.0) and GHSA-8xhq-x7vw-8rcw (medium, fixed in 0.12.0). Hash as crates.io lists it on 14 Nov 2026.

sources.name: vmlx-swift
sources.role: Pure-Swift MLX + JANGH2 + DSpark speculative decoding runtime (MIT, zero Python) built into vmlx-worker/cloak-worker-vmlx for fast Local Mode chat models such as OsaurusAI/Inkling-2-Mini-JANGH2. Matches the exact revision pinned in vmlx-worker/Package.swift.
